response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS test_records FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), compared AS (SELECT sex, test_records, 1.0 * test_records / SUM(test_records) OVER () AS share_of_total, test_records - AVG(test_records) OVER () AS above_average FROM counts) SELECT sex, test_records, share_of_total, above_average FROM compared WHERE above_average > 0
